commands.name: gsettings
commands.summary: Read and change GNOME and application settings stored in GSettings.
commands.source: Fedora 44 installed command set; consult the command manual for version-specific details.

optionDescriptions.list-keys: List keys available in the selected schema.
optionDescriptions.get: Print the current value of a schema key.
optionDescriptions.set: Set a schema key to the supplied value.
optionDescriptions.reset: Restore a key to its schema default.
optionDescriptions.--schemadir: Search this directory for additional GSettings schemas.

searchTerms: change GNOME desktop setting from terminal

commands.name: dconf
commands.summary: Read and write the dconf configuration database.
commands.source: Fedora 44 installed command set; consult the command manual for version-specific details.

optionDescriptions.read: Read and print the value at a dconf database path.
optionDescriptions.write: Write a value to a dconf database path.
optionDescriptions.reset: Reset a path or key to its default value.
optionDescriptions.dump: Export values under a path as a text stream.
optionDescriptions.load: Import values from a text stream under a path.
optionDescriptions.watch: Print changes made beneath a dconf path.
